newsitem.title: USA: Adelphia's Hyperion files for stock offer.
newsitem.headline: Adelphia's Hyperion files for stock offer.

text.p: Adelphia Communications Corp said on Tuesday its subsidiary Hyperion Telecommunications Inc filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to offer its Class A common stock.
The company said Hyperion aimed to raise about $200 million in gross proceeds by issuing its Class A common stock, before underwriters exercised their over-allotment option.
The company was not immediately available to comment on what Hyperion planned to do with funds it raised.

Hyperion is a competitive local exchange carrier which designs, constructs, operates and manages fiber optic networks and facilities, mostly through joint ventures in the eastern United States. It is 89 percent-owned by Adelphia, the seventh largest cable television operator in the United States.
The company said the registration statement was not yet effective and no Class A common stock could be bought or sold until it was.
Goldman, Sachs & Co would be the managing underwriter for the offering and Bear, Stearns & Co Inc, Lazard Freres & Co LLC and Merrill Lynch & Co would be co-managers.
